pages.text: A $(thing)Moxon$() is a two-element beam bent into a rectangle. It sends and hears half as much again in the way it points, and a tenth of that behind it, close by and on skip alike.$(br2)It points from the $(thing)reflector$() (the back) to the $(thing)driven element$() (the front, on the balun).

pages.title: Building it
pages.text: Front: a $(item)1:1 balun$() with wire straight out both ways to the front corners, then a wire back from each corner, the same length both sides.$(br2)Leave a one block gap, then the reflector: from a holder just behind each tail, wire back to the back corners and across between them. Lie it flat.$(br2)20 m: 7 wide, 3 deep. 10 m: 3 wide, 2 deep.

pages.name: A 20 m Moxon
pages.text: Wire balun to both front poles, each front pole one back, then the reflector from the third poles round the back. It beams away from the reflector.
